# Trimester-specific ultrasound references

Reviewed September 19, 2026. Match is established from captions, article scope and rendered PDF figures. A matching trimester is not a claim that every frame meets every Best criterion. Missing mappings deliberately do not use a different trimester or a different anatomical plane.

The Ruican images and their panel presentations remain CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. They are separate assets, with no change to the other materials’ licenses. Cardiac phase descriptions in Ruican Figure 1 are inconsistent with their valve descriptions; those panels are NOT used to claim phase verification. Only Soltan Figures 2a/3a supply phase-specific 4CV examples.
